From: alerts@medwatch-systems.com
To: safety@clinicverse.com
Subject: MedWatch Alert: Device Recall - Pulse Oximeter Model PX-500
Date: 2025-08-25T11:00:00Z

MEDWATCH SAFETY ALERT

FDA Recall Classification: Class II
Recall Number: 2025-RCL-0892

Device Information:
Device: VitaCheck Pulse Oximeter
Model: PX-500
Manufacturer: MedWatch Systems Inc.
UDI: 00123456789012
Manufacturing Dates: January 2025 - June 2025
Estimated Units Affected: 12,500

Issue Description:
The PX-500 Pulse Oximeter may display inaccurate SpO2 readings (±5% variance) when patient perfusion index is below 0.4%. This could lead to:
- Failure to detect hypoxemia
- Delayed clinical intervention
- Potential patient harm in critical care settings

Reports Received:
- 47 complaints received
- 3 adverse event reports (no injuries)
- 0 deaths

Affected Facilities:
Hospitals and clinics that purchased PX-500 units between January-June 2025.

Recommended Actions:
1. Immediately check all PX-500 units in inventory
2. Quarantine affected units
3. Contact MedWatch Systems for replacement units
4. Report any adverse events to MedWatch

Contact for Replacement:
MedWatch Systems Customer Service
Phone: 1-800-555-0199
Email: recall@medwatch-systems.com

This alert was automatically generated by the MedWatch Safety System.
